newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - KPN raises TNT stake to 14.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - KPN raises TNT stake to 14.9 pct.

text.p: Dutch postal and telecoms group Koninklijke PTT Nederaland NV (KPN) said on Tuesday it had increased its stake in takeover target TNT Ltd to 14.9 percent from 9.9 percent.
KPN said it purchased 29.273 million TNT shares on the Australian share market on Tuesday at prices up to A$2.45 each, the same as its offer price.
The friendly bid values the international transport company at A$2.0 billion.
KPN also said it had increased its stake in TNT converting preference shares to 14.9 percent with the purchase of 10.5 million preference shares at prices up to A$2.51 each.
